name: sparx — Pizzeria
tagline: Flour, fire, and a long table — a working template for a pizzeria that books tables.
description: A complete, working site for a wood-fired pizzeria & trattoria: a real menu (antipasti, pizza, pasta, dolci, drinks) and a live table-reservations flow (tables as bookable resources, party-size reservation services, opening hours, a cancellation policy) on the /reserve page. Warm terracotta theme — cream, tomato-brick red, a basil-green accent. Pages: Home, Menu, Reserve, About, Visit. Shipped as Forno.
